title: Integrating the Analytic Hierarchy Process with Large Language Models for Transparent Multi-Criteria Decision-Making
abstract: arXiv:2609.16779v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLMs are increasingly employed in a wide range of decision-making tasks. However, the opacity of their internal reasoning makes it difficult to validate or interpret their outputs, and the need for interpretability becomes especially critical in high-stakes settings. This study examines the decision-making capabilities of LLMs through the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP), a classical and widely used multicriteria decision-making framework. We construct a new annotated benchmark based on AHP and propose the first end-to-end approach that enables LLMs to perform the complete AHP workflow. Experiments in real-world decision problems in the legal and higher-education ranking domains show that our method significantly improves alignment with expert judgments.

translated_title: 将层次分析法与大语言模型集成以实现透明化多准则决策
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）正日益被广泛应用于各类决策任务中。然而，其内部推理过程的不透明性使得验证或解释其输出变得困难，而在高风险场景下，对可解释性的需求尤为关键。本研究通过层次分析法（AHP）这一经典且广泛使用的多准则决策框架，考察了大语言模型的决策能力。我们构建了一个基于AHP的全新标注基准，并提出了首个使大语言模型能够执行完整AHP工作流程的端到端方法。在法律和高等教育排名领域的真实决策问题上的实验表明，我们的方法显著提升了与专家判断的一致性。
tldr: 本研究提出首个使大语言模型执行完整层次分析法（AHP）工作流程的端到端方法，并构建了基于AHP的标注基准，显著提升了模型决策与专家判断的一致性。
en_tdlr: This study proposes the first end-to-end approach enabling LLMs to perform the complete Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) workflow, along with a new annotated AHP-based benchmark, significantly improving alignment with expert judgments.
